method: Hand review of design/parity/evidence/<row>/comparison.png (reference, built, pixelmatch diff) against Material Design 3 component anatomy and the checked-in reference.

primitives.finding: Primary-container banner with info glyph stating the append-only rule sits under the filter row (repaired 2026-09-01); the feed summary stays as the supporting line.

Rows carry the kind badge (EDIT/SETTINGS/RESTORE/DELETE), label, short digest at the right edge and the meta line (repaired 2026-09-01). The fixture has one revision; the reference lists fourteen. CREATE is not distinguished from EDIT for entry revisions.
All/Created/Edited/Deleted/Restored/Settings chips present; built adds date pickers.
Reference shows a detail card with diff and Restore action; built exposes a Diff button per row.

defects.summary: Detail card with diff and Restore action not built; rows expose Diff per row
CREATE badge not distinguished from EDIT for entry revisions

deviations.reason: The fixture database has one history revision (the first save); the reference shows an authored eight-revision timeline. Data, not chrome.
